title: A failure state a criterion names needs a mock path that produces it
rule: When an acceptance criterion asks the UI to show a failure (a file that cannot come back, a scan error, a refused activation), make the MockApi able to produce that state on demand (an option and a `?mock…=` URL parameter) and add a Playwright check that reaches it and asserts the visible text. A mock that only ever succeeds leaves the failure row untested, and it can regress to a bare or wrong label with every test green.
rationale: E56.15 (#675): History's 'Cannot come back — <reason>' row (criterion 3) had no test because the TypeScript mock's undo always restored every file.
